name: Proxies
description: Renders 1280x720 ProRes Proxy files for a bin (ffmpeg, REDline for R3D) into a folder tree that mirrors the bins, then attaches them. Never deletes or overwrites a proxy. Leave Bin empty to use the bins selected in the Project panel.

actions.label: Detach proxies
actions.confirm: Detach the proxies of every clip in this bin scope? (No files are deleted.)

actions.label: Cancel
actions.confirm: Cancel the render? Running ffmpeg/REDline jobs are killed; partial files stay on disk.
